title: Accounts Payable
description:
This Accounts Payable position in Southampton is a temporary role within the technology and security sector, focusing on managing invoices and payments to keep the finance function running smoothly. You'll play a vital part in ensuring suppliers are paid accurately and on time, supporting the overall efficiency of the business.

Client Details

An organization based in Southampton within the technology and security sector.

Description
- Process supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Reconcile supplier statements to ensure all payments are accounted for.
- Manage payment runs and prioritise urgent payments when required.
- Respond to supplier queries and resolve discrepancies.
- Maintain up-to-date records of all payable transactions.
- Assist with month-end processes, including reconciliations and reporting.
- Support the wider finance team with ad-hoc tasks as needed.

Profile

A successful Accounts Payable should have:
- Previous experience in a similar accounts payable role.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Proficiency in using accounting software and Excel.
- Good communication skills to liaise with suppliers and internal teams.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and managing deadlines.

Job Offer
- Hourly pay between £13.00 and £15.00, dependent on the level of experience.
- Temporary position with the potential to gain valuable experience.
- Annual leave allowance as part of a competitive benefits package.
- Access to a pension scheme.

title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Southampton, you'll play a key role in managing the company's finances by ensuring timely payments and maintaining healthy customer accounts. This role is essential to supporting the smooth running of the accounting and finance operations within the transport and distribution industry.

Client Details

A transport and distribution company based in Southampton.

Description
- Manage and monitor customer accounts to ensure timely payments.
- Conduct credit checks and set up new customer accounts.
- Resolve payment queries and disputes efficiently.
- Prepare and distribute accurate account statements.
- Work closely with the sales and finance teams to address account issues.
- Maintain accurate records of all account activity.
- Produce regular reports on outstanding debts and cash flow.
- Ensure compliance with company credit policies and procedures.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience in credit control or a similar accounting and finance role.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Attention to detail and excellent organisational abilities.
- Proficiency in financial software and MS Office, especially Excel.
- The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position based in Southampton.
- Competitive benefits package.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

description: We are looking for a flexible and well-organised Business Support Administrator to join our Community Specialist Services Division within Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust. Based at the Royal South Hants Hospital, you will play a key role in supporting both patients and clinical teams by ensuring the smooth running of administrative processes for the Diabetes Service. This is an exciting chance to work in a patient focussed environment where your contribution will have a direct impact on delivering patient care. Please see the Job Description and person specification attached for more details. attached. What We're Looking For: *Excellent organisational and time management skills. *Strong communication and interpersonal abilities. *Confidence working independently and as part of a wider team. *Flexibility to adapt to changing service needs and working patterns. *Previous administrative experience *Carry out clinical diary management, booking rooms, patient appointments, professional meetings, and resolving any queries with clinicians *Manage appointment bookings, updating electronic record system and sending appointment letters following Trust guidelines and targets *Ensure referrals are actioned following the agreed service procedures according to the defined performance targets and timescales *Produce letters, emails or memoranda using standardised Trust templates ensuring accurate filing, recording and distribution *Produce accurate minutes and full administration support for a range of meetings and investigations to include agenda preparation and follow up of appropriate actions *Process incoming and outgoing mail, telephone, or written messages, distributing appropriately and in a timely manner, taking responsibility for signposting or dealing with queries regarding issues arising *Liaising by telephone or in person with clients, colleagues, and other healthcare professionals in a positive, friendly, calm and sympathetic manner, using good judgement to identify requirements in order to pass on information correctly or take appropriate action.
